proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the matching mouse-up through dismissal (1/4)

**Severity:** `high`

An outside click can swallow `WM_LBUTTONDOWN`, then hide the overlay before the physical release. Keep `MouseHookProc` active for that pending `WM_LBUTTONUP` even while the overlay is hidden; otherwise it cannot swallow the matching up. Apply all four grouped suggestions together.

```suggestion
    if (code == HC_ACTION && g_uiThreadId &&
        (g_overlayVisible.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ||
         (wParam == WM_LBUTTONUP && g_swallowedLeftDown.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))))
```

proposed_comments.body:
### Defer teardown while the button-up is pending (4/4)

**Severity:** `high`

`HideOverlayWindow()` calls `RemoveEscapeHook()` immediately after an outside click. Clearing `g_swallowedLeftDown` and removing the mouse hook here lets the physical `WM_LBUTTONUP` reach the underlying app without its matching down. Defer that unhook until the release is consumed; the shutdown suggestion still forces cleanup. Apply all four grouped suggestions together.

```suggestion
    if (g_mouseHook && !g_swallowedLeftDown.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
```
